local CommonFunc = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("CommonFunc"))
local CommonEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Common"):WaitForChild("CommonEnum"))
local GameEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))
local ValueHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ValueHelper"))
local GameHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))
local BagHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("BagHelper"))
local MapHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("MapHelper"))
local UIHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("UIHelper"))
local AudioHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("AudioHelper"))
local ResourcesItemHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ResourcesItemHelper"))

local PlayerAttributeValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.PlayerAttributeValue
local PlayerValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.PlayerValue
local CharacterValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.CharacterValue

local _originHumanoid:Humanoid = game.StarterPlayer.Humanoid

function onUpdateWalkSpeed(player:Player)
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end

    local humanoid:Humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

    local v_walkSpeedBonus:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(character,CharacterValue.WalkSpeedBonus)
    humanoid.WalkSpeed = _originHumanoid.WalkSpeed + v_walkSpeedBonus.Value
end

function onUpdateMaxHealth(player:Players)
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end

    local humanoid:Humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    local v_MaxHealthBonus:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(character,CharacterValue.MaxHealthBonus)
    humanoid.MaxHealth = _originHumanoid.MaxHealth + _originHumanoid.MaxHealth * v_MaxHealthBonus.Value
    if humanoid.Health > humanoid.MaxHealth then
        humanoid.Health = humanoid.MaxHealth
    end
end

ValueHelper.onInit.Event:Connect(function(player:Player,model:Configuration)
    if PlayerValue ~= model then return end

    local v_hunger:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(player,PlayerValue.hunger)
    local v_gamehungerRate:NumberValue = workspace.GameValue:FindFirstChild("饥饿值下降倍率")

    while player do
        local dt = task.wait(1)
        if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then continue end
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid:Humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

        -- 饥饿衰减
        local baseHungerCost = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.baseHungerCost)
        local hungerCostBonus = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.hungerCostBonus)
        local costHunger = baseHungerCost
        costHunger *= v_gamehungerRate.Value -- -- 乘以该游戏模式的饥饿值下降倍率
        if character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.WalkSpeedBuff.Run) then
            local humanoidRootPart:Part = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local speed = (humanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity * CommonEnum.XZ).Magnitude
            if speed >= 1 and not humanoid.Sit then
                local runHungerCost = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.runHungerCost)
                costHunger += runHungerCost
            end

            -- print(costHunger)
        end
        costHunger += costHunger * hungerCostBonus -- 计算接加成，负是降低，正是增加
        if costHunger < 0 then costHunger = 0 end

        if v_hunger.Value > 0 then
            local newHunger = v_hunger.Value - costHunger
            if newHunger < 0 then
                newHunger = 0
            end
            v_hunger.Value =  newHunger
        else
            local humanoid:Humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            if humanoid then
                humanoid:TakeDamage(humanoid.MaxHealth * 0.1)
            end
        end

        -- 血量恢复
        GameHelper:PlayerAutoHeal(player,1)
    end
end)
ValueHelper.onInit.Event:Connect(function(character:Model,model:Configuration)
    if CharacterValue ~= model then return end
    local player = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
    local v_walkSpeedBonus:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(character,CharacterValue.WalkSpeedBonus)
    local v_MaxHealthBonus:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(character,CharacterValue.MaxHealthBonus)
    local v_poisonMeter:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(character,CharacterValue.poisonMeter)
    local v_freezeMeter:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(character,CharacterValue.freezeMeter)

    onUpdateWalkSpeed(player)
    onUpdateMaxHealth(player)
    v_walkSpeedBonus.Changed:Connect(function()
        onUpdateWalkSpeed(player)
    end)
    v_MaxHealthBonus.Changed:Connect(function()
        onUpdateMaxHealth(player)
    end)
    v_poisonMeter.Changed:Connect(function()
        if v_poisonMeter.Value >= GameEnum.PosionMax then
            -- 中毒值满，标记中毒
            if not character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Poisoned) then
                character:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Poisoned)
                UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player,"You're poisoned!😵",UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
            end
        elseif v_poisonMeter.Value <= 0 then
            -- 中毒值清零，移除中毒
            if character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Poisoned) then
                character:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.Poisoned)
            end
        end
    end)
    v_freezeMeter.Changed:Connect(function()
        if v_freezeMeter.Value >= GameEnum.FreezeMax then
            -- 冰冷值满，标记冰冷
            if not character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Freezed) then
                character:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Freezed)
                UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player,"You're freezed!❄",UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
            end
        elseif v_freezeMeter.Value <= 0 then
            -- 冰冷值清零，移除冰冷
            if character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Freezed) then
                character:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.Freezed)
            end
        end
    end)

    while character and character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) do
        -- 中毒相关
        if character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.InMarshGas) then
            -- 在下雨的泥沼泽中，提上中毒值
            if v_poisonMeter.Value < GameEnum.PosionMax then
                local poisonResistance = ValueHelper:WaitValueValue(character,CharacterValue.poisonResistance)
                local up = math.clamp(10 - poisonResistance,0,10)
                v_poisonMeter.Value = math.clamp(v_poisonMeter.Value + up,0,GameEnum.PosionMax)
            end
        else
            if v_poisonMeter.Value > 0 then
                v_poisonMeter.Value = math.clamp(v_poisonMeter.Value - 1,0,GameEnum.PosionMax)
            end
        end

        -- 寒冷相关
        if character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OnSnowfieldGround) then -- 在雪原
            if v_freezeMeter.Value < GameEnum.FreezeMax and
            not character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.WarnLampBuff) then -- 没有暖暖灯效果
                GameHelper:PlayerAddFreezeMeter(player,GameHelper.SnowfieldColdAdd)
            end
        else
            if v_freezeMeter.Value > 0 then
                -- v_freezeMeter.Value = math.clamp(v_freezeMeter.Value - 1,0,GameEnum.FreezeMax)
                GameHelper:PlayerAddFreezeMeter(player,-1)
            end
        end

        -- 在暴风雪中，超级寒冷
        if character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.InSnowstorm) then
            GameHelper:PlayerAddFreezeMeter(player,10)
        end

        if character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Poisoned) then
            -- 中毒状态下，每秒扣血
            GameHelper:PlayerTakeDamage(player,1,nil,true)
        end
        task.wait(1)
    end
end)

CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(GameEnum.Tag.InBag):Connect(function(item:Model)
    local humanoid:Humanoid = item:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if humanoid then
        humanoid:SetAttribute("OriginDisplayDistanceType",humanoid.DisplayDistanceType)
        humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
    end

    if item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Player) then
        CommonFunc:ForDescendant(item,function(basePart:BasePart)
            if item.PrimaryPart == basePart then return end
            if basePart:IsA("BasePart") and basePart.Anchored == false then
                basePart:SetAttribute("InBagAnchored",true)
                basePart.Anchored = true
            end
        end)

        local player = BagHelper:GetInWhoBag(item)
        local offset = Vector3.new(0,50,0)
        while player and player.Character and player.Character.PrimaryPart and item and item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.InBag) do
            local pos = player.Character.PrimaryPart.CFrame.Position
            local ground:Part = MapHelper:GetGroundPart(MapHelper:Pos2Grid1(pos))
            if ground and pos.Y > ground.Position.Y then
                -- 在地面上
                 pos = Vector3.new(pos.X,ground.Position.Y - 5,pos.Z)
            else
                -- 在地下
                pos -= offset
            end

            item:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos))
            -- print(item.Name,"尸体在背包里设置位置",pos)
            -- print("跟随")
            task.wait(1)
        end
    end
end)

end)

    onJumpPowerBonusChanged()
    table.insert(connections,v_JumpPowerBonus.Changed:Connect(onJumpPowerBonusChanged))
end)"},{"id":363,"text":"local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local CommonFunc = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("CommonFunc"))
local CommonEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Common"):WaitForChild("CommonEnum"))
local GameEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))
local ValueHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ValueHelper"))
local EnemyHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("EnemyHelper"))
local GameHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))
local AudioHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("AudioHelper"))
local ResourcesItemHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ResourcesItemHelper"))

local EnemyValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.EnemyValue
local NpcAttributeValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.NpcAttributeValue
local escortTargets = {}
for _, target in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.EscortTarget)) do
	escortTargets[target] = true
end
CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(GameEnum.Tag.EscortTarget):Connect(function(target)
	escortTargets[target] = true
end)
CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal(GameEnum.Tag.EscortTarget):Connect(function(target)
	escortTargets[target] = nil
end)

math.randomseed(tick())

local function getClosestPlayer(enemy:Model,aggroDistance:number)
	local humanoidRootPart:Part = enemy.PrimaryPart
	local closest = nil
	local shortestDist = aggroDistance
	for _, player in pairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
		if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then continue end
		local character:Model = player.Character
		local playerRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if character and character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Player) and playerRoot then
			local playerPos = playerRoot.Position
			local dist = (playerPos - humanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
			if dist <= shortestDist then
				if GameHelper:IsInCampfire(playerPos) and dist > 10 then
					continue
				end
				if not CommonFunc:IsModelObstructionByCollsionGroup(enemy,character,GameEnum.CollisionGroup.Environment) then
					closest = player
					shortestDist = dist
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return closest, shortestDist
end

local function getClosestEscort(enemy:Model,aggroDistance:number)
	local humanoidRootPart:Part = enemy.PrimaryPart
	local closest = nil
	local shortestDist = aggroDistance
	for target in pairs(escortTargets) do
		if target ~= enemy and target.Parent and GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(target) then
			local targetRoot = target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or target.PrimaryPart
			if targetRoot then
				local dist = (targetRoot.Position - humanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
				if dist <= shortestDist then
					if GameHelper:IsInCampfire(targetRoot.Position) and dist > 10 then
						continue
					end
					if not CommonFunc:IsModelObstructionByCollsionGroup(enemy,target,GameEnum.CollisionGroup.Environment) then
						closest = target
						shortestDist = dist
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return closest, shortestDist
end

function onTagAdded(enemy:Model,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
	enemy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.NPCAutoJump)
	local humanoidRootPart:Part = enemy.PrimaryPart
	if not humanoidRootPart then return end
	local humanoid:Humanoid = enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
	humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated,false)
	humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming,false)
	humanoid.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
	humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
	CommonFunc:SetCollisionGroup(enemy,GameEnum.CollisionGroup.Enemy)
	local id = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(enemy,EnemyValue.id)
	local atkDamage = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(enemy,EnemyValue.atkDamage)
	local v_targetPlayer:ObjectValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(enemy,EnemyValue.targetPlayer)
	local v_walkSpeed:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(enemy,NpcAttributeValue.walkSpeed)

	local lo = EnemyHelper:GetLo(id)
	humanoid.NameDisplayDistance = lo.aggroDistance
	local originWalkSpeed = v_walkSpeed.Value
	local originPos = humanoidRootPart.Position
	local attackWalkSpeedDown = humanoid.WalkSpeed * 0.5
	local attackTrack:AnimationTrack
	local animations = enemy:FindFirstChild("Animations")
	local attackAnimation = animations and animations:FindFirstChild("attack")
	if attackAnimation and attackAnimation:IsA("Animation") then
		local success, loadedTrack = pcall(function()
			return CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(enemy,attackAnimation)
		end)
		if success and loadedTrack then
			attackTrack = loadedTrack
			attackTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2
			attackTrack.Looped = false
			attackTrack:Stop()
		end
	end
	local wander_cd:number = 0
	local atkCD = 0
	local chase_cd:number = 0
	local forceTime = 10
	local campfireBackupCD = 0
	local targetProbeCD = 0
	local targetPlayer:Player = nil
	local targetEscort:Model = nil
	local syncingTargetValue = false

	local function updatePatrolSpeed()
		if targetPlayer or targetEscort then
			ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(enemy,NpcAttributeValue.walkSpeed,"巡逻",0)
		else
			ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(enemy,NpcAttributeValue.walkSpeed,"巡逻",-originWalkSpeed*0.5)
		end
	end

	local function setTargetPlayer(player:Player)
		targetPlayer = player
		targetEscort = nil
		syncingTargetValue = true
		v_targetPlayer.Value = player
		syncingTargetValue = false
		updatePatrolSpeed()
	end

	local function setTargetEscort(target:Model)
		targetPlayer = nil
		targetEscort = target
		syncingTargetValue = true
		v_targetPlayer.Value = nil
		syncingTargetValue = false
		updatePatrolSpeed()
	end

	local function clearTarget()
		setTargetPlayer(nil)
	end

	local function getTargetModel()
		if targetEscort then
			return targetEscort
		end
		return targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Character
	end

	local function isTargetAlive()
		if targetEscort then
			return escortTargets[targetEscort] == true and GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(targetEscort)
		end
		return GameHelper:isAlive(targetPlayer)
	end

	local function acquireClosestTarget(maxDistance)
		local player, playerDistance = getClosestPlayer(enemy,maxDistance)
		local escort, escortDistance = getClosestEscort(enemy,maxDistance)
		if escort and escortDistance < playerDistance then
			setTargetEscort(escort)
			return escort
		end
		setTargetPlayer(player)
		return player
	end

	setTargetPlayer(nil)
	table.insert(connections,v_targetPlayer.Changed:Connect(function()
		if syncingTargetValue then return end
		local value = v_targetPlayer.Value
		if value and value:IsA("Player") then
			targetPlayer = value
			targetEscort = nil
		else
			targetPlayer = nil
			targetEscort = nil
		end
		updatePatrolSpeed()
		if value then
			forceTime = 10
		end
	end))
	table.insert(connections,humanoid.MoveToFinished:Connect(function()
		wander_cd = math.random(10, 20)
	end))

	table.insert(connections,humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(health)
		if health < humanoid.MaxHealth and not isTargetAlive() then
			local newTarget = acquireClosestTarget(lo.aggroDistance)
			if newTarget then
				forceTime = 10
			end
		end

		if health <= 0 then
			GameHelper:EnemyDeathDrop(enemy)
			enemy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Ragdoll)
			enemy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.AnimalDeath)
			enemy:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.Enemy)
			enemy:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.Animal)
		end
	end))

	table.insert(connections,RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt:number)
		if not enemy or not enemy.PrimaryPart then
			enemy:Destroy()
			return
		end
		if humanoidRootPart.Anchored then return end
		chase_cd -= dt
		wander_cd -= dt
		atkCD -= dt
		forceTime -= dt
		campfireBackupCD -= dt
		targetProbeCD -= dt

		local previousTarget = getTargetModel()
		if targetProbeCD <= 0 and (not isTargetAlive() or forceTime <= 0) then
			targetProbeCD = 0.75
			local newTarget = acquireClosestTarget(lo.aggroDistance)
			if newTarget and getTargetModel() ~= previousTarget then
				forceTime = 10
			end
		end

		if isTargetAlive() then
			local targetModel = getTargetModel()
			local targetHRP = targetModel and (targetModel:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or targetModel.PrimaryPart)
			if not targetHRP then
				clearTarget()
				return
			end
			local targetPos = targetHRP.Position
			local offset = targetHRP.Position - humanoidRootPart.Position
			local distToTarget = offset.Magnitude
			if forceTime <= 0 and distToTarget > lo.aggroDistance then
				clearTarget()
				return
			end

			if GameHelper:IsInCampfire(humanoidRootPart.Position) and campfireBackupCD <= 0 then
				campfireBackupCD = 10
				clearTarget()
				chase_cd = 1
				wander_cd = 10
				forceTime = 0
				humanoid:MoveTo(originPos)
				return
			end

			if chase_cd <= 0 then
				humanoid:MoveTo(targetPos)
			end

function onInitAnimation(buddy:Model,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    local humanoid:Humanoid = buddy:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    local tool:Tool = buddy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")

    local animations:Folder = buddy:FindFirstChild("Animations")
    if not animations then return end

    local v_targetEnemy:ObjectValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(buddy,AnimalBuddyValue.targetEnemy)

    local walkAnim:Animation = animations:FindFirstChild("walk")
    local runAnim:Animation = animations:FindFirstChild("run")
    local walkTrack:AnimationTrack
    local runTrack:AnimationTrack
    if walkAnim then
        walkTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(buddy,walkAnim)
        if not walkTrack then
            warn("找不到敌人动画:",buddy.Name)
        end
        walkTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement
        walkTrack.Looped = true
        walkTrack:Stop()
    end
    if runAnim then
        runTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(buddy,runAnim)
        runTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement
        runTrack.Looped = true
        runTrack:Stop()
    end

    local playMoveAnim = function()
        if v_targetEnemy.Value then
            if runTrack then
                if walkTrack.IsPlaying then walkTrack:Stop() end
                if not runTrack.IsPlaying then runTrack:Play() end
            else
                if not walkTrack.IsPlaying then walkTrack:Play() end
            end
        else
            if not walkTrack.IsPlaying then walkTrack:Play() end
            if runTrack and runTrack.IsPlaying then runTrack:Stop() end
        end
    end

    local stopMoveAnim = function()
        if walkTrack and walkTrack.IsPlaying then walkTrack:Stop() end
        if runTrack and runTrack.IsPlaying then runTrack:Stop() end
    end

    stopMoveAnim()
    table.insert(connections,humanoid.Running:Connect(function(speed)
        if speed > 1 then
            playMoveAnim()
        else
            stopMoveAnim()
        end
    end))

    if tool then
        local attackAnim:Animation = animations:FindFirstChild("attack")
        if attackAnim then
            local attackTrack:AnimationTrack
            table.insert(connections,tool.Activated:Connect(function()
                -- print(enemy.Name)
                if not attackTrack then
                    attackTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(buddy,attackAnim)
                    attackTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2
                    attackTrack.Looped = false
                end
                attackTrack:Play()
                -- attackTrack:AdjustSpeed(3)
            end))
        end

        local toolAnim:Animation = animations:FindFirstChild("tool")
        if toolAnim then
            local toolTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(buddy,toolAnim)
            toolTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
            toolTrack.Looped = true
            toolTrack:Play()
            table.insert(connections,tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
                if not toolTrack.IsPlaying then toolTrack:Play() end
            end))
            table.insert(connections,tool.Unequipped:Connect(function()
                if toolTrack.IsPlaying then toolTrack:Stop() end
            end))
        end

    end
end

    local function setTargetEscort(target:Model)
        targetPlayer = nil
        targetEscort = target

        end
    end

    local function clearTarget()
        targetPlayer = nil
        targetEscort = nil
        if v_targetPlayer.Value then
            v_targetPlayer.Value = nil
        end
    end

    local function getTargetModel()
        if targetEscort then
            return targetEscort
        end
        return targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Character
    end

    local function isTargetAlive()
        if targetEscort then
            return escortTargets[targetEscort] == true and GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(targetEscort)
        end
        return GameHelper:isAlive(targetPlayer)
    end

    local function distanceToModel(model)
        local root = model and (model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model.PrimaryPart)
        if not root then
            return math.huge
        end
        return (root.Position - humanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
    end

    local function findClosestEscort(maxDistance)
        local closest
        local closestDistance = maxDistance
        for target in pairs(escortTargets) do
            if bandit:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OldCowboyAmbusher)
                and not target:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OldCowboyCompanion) then
                continue
            end
            if target ~= bandit and target.Parent and GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(target) then
                local distance = distanceToModel(target)
                if distance <= closestDistance then
                    closest = target
                    closestDistance = distance
                end
            end
        end
        return closest, closestDistance
    end

    local function acquireClosestTarget(maxDistance)
        if bandit:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OldCowboyAmbusher) then
            local oldCowboy = findClosestEscort(math.max(maxDistance,300))
            if oldCowboy then
                setTargetEscort(oldCowboy)
                return oldCowboy
            end
        end

        local player = GameHelper:GetClosestPlayer(bandit,maxDistance)
        local playerDistance = player and distanceToModel(player.Character) or math.huge
        local escort, escortDistance = findClosestEscort(maxDistance)
        if escort and escortDistance < playerDistance then
            setTargetEscort(escort)
            return escort
        end
        setTargetPlayer(player)
        return player
    end
